content.title: Fix inverted counterpart filter in dependency-manager
content.description: Fix a one-line bug in the dependency manager where the filter condition for removing counterpart blockage entries uses the wrong variable. The filter checks e.blockerId === issueId when it should check e.blockerId === entry.blockerId. This causes counterpart entries to not be cleaned up when deleting a blocked issue. Found during validation of delete command.

content.content:
Fixed the inverted filter condition at line 200 of dependency-manager.ts. Changed `e.blockerId === issueId` to `e.blockerId === entry.blockerId` in the first loop of `removeAllBlockagesForIssue`. 

The bug: When iterating over `blockedByEntries` (entries where issueId is the blocked issue), the filter was checking `e.blockerId === issueId` against the blocker's blocks list. Since `issueId` is the blocked issue (not the blocker), the condition never matched, so counterpart entries in `blocks[]` were never cleaned up.

The second loop (line 223) was already correct — there `issueId` IS the blocker so `e.blockerId === issueId` is right.

Verified: typecheck passes, all 28 dependency-manager tests pass. The 5 pre-existing test failures in mentions are unrelated.
